Subject: Re: Post-call recap & next steps — Redwood x Orchard Health

Hi Samantha — thanks for the rapid turnaround and the artifacts. I pulled the attachments into the intake folder and skimmed them. A few clarifying questions so we scope the review correctly: 

1) PHI: you noted Epic ingestion — can you confirm whether Redwood will process direct identifiers (name, MRN) or only clinical text (notes)?
2) Environments: Please confirm which environments are in scope for the initial review (prod only vs. prod + staging/dev).
3) Integrations: how will Okta be configured? will Redwood be on the same Okta tenant or a separate service account?
4) Third parties: list any third-party processors outside Redwood and Epic that will touch PHI (analytics vendors, logging, backups).
5) Compliance artifacts: please attach your SOC 2 (if available) and any required DPA language or contract redlines the procurement team expects.

If you prefer, we can capture these answers in a short intake template — attaching one I usually use to speed things up.

Proposed next steps:
- Once we have the intake answers and artifacts, I'll run an initial scope assessment and share a short findings/ask list (48-72 hours).
- Then we schedule a 60-minute security kickoff with your security/IT and procurement to review remaining items.

Can you confirm best times for a kickoff on 2027-09-20 or 2027-09-21? 

Thanks again — looping Neha to help with logistics.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Security Solutions Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Attachment: security-kickoff-intake.docx (document, 30KB)

From: Samantha Jones <s.jones@orchardhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Tom Alvarez <t.alvarez@orchardhealth.com>, Carlos Mendez <c.mendez@orchardhealth.com>, Lisa Park <l.park@orchardhealth.com>
Date: 2027-09-16T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & next steps — Redwood x Orchard Health

Marissa — thanks for the intake template, answering inline below and attaching procurement contacts CSV: 

1) PHI: initial integration will pass clinical notes and structured fields; direct identifiers will be hashed before being sent to Redwood for the initial pilot.
2) Environments: pilot will include prod + a mirrored staging environment.
3) Okta: Redwood will authenticate via a service account in our Okta tenant (same tenant).
4) Third parties: backups handled by our managed services partner (ClearCloud) and logging via LogStream (both may see metadata).
5) Artifacts: attaching SOC2 report (we don't publish publicly) — procurement will share DPA template during contract stage.

Procurement timeline: initial review week of 9/22, contract negotiations through 10/15. Economic buyer (Tom Alvarez) is looped for visibility.

Let us know which kickoff slot works and if you need additional documents.

Thanks,
Samantha
